---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## What problem does this solve?

A clear description of the problem or gap. E.g. "Members can't tell which
announcements are new without opening every one."

## Describe the solution you'd like

What you want to happen, in as much or as little detail as you have.

## Describe alternatives you've considered

Any other approaches you thought about, and why this one seems best.

## Additional context

Mockups, screenshots, or links to similar features elsewhere, if helpful.
